reply.text: That sounds like a real injury, not a training question, and I'm not the right person to assess it. Please see a doctor or physio about your arm and shoulder, and get it looked at soon, especially since you can't lift it above shoulder height. Once they've cleared you, I'll work around whatever they tell you to avoid, so let me know their guidance when you have it. Until then, I'd hold off on any overhead or pressing work.
